Market today: The market's shaky, driven by geopolitical tensions and oil prices. Tech, especially chips, is getting hit hard, and your concentrated, leveraged book feels it.

Your holdings: QQQ (-7.41%), SMH (-20.77%), and SOXL (-63.85%) are all marked SELL and need attention. Your margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep an eye on the semiconductor sector's reaction to Samsung's results and any further escalation in the Middle East.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your risk in these volatile tech and chip names.
plays: Trim QQQ if it breaks below its stop at 670.
Consider trimming SMH given its deep losses and SELL status.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
